# Verify the Dyck-style completion of "< < >" and the submitted answer "< < > >".

pairs = {'<': '>'}
openers = set(pairs)
closers = set(pairs.values())

def balanced(tokens):
    stack = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t in openers:
            stack.append(t)
        elif t in closers:
            if not stack or pairs[stack[-1]] != t:
                return False
            stack.pop()
        else:
            return False
    return not stack

inp = "< < >".split()
submitted = "< < > >".split()

# Compute the expected minimal completion: close all unmatched openers.
stack = []
for t in inp:
    if t in openers:
        stack.append(t)
    else:
        stack.pop()
completion = [pairs[o] for o in reversed(stack)]
expected_full = inp + completion

print("input:", inp)
print("unmatched openers:", stack)
print("minimal completion:", completion)
print("expected full sequence:", " ".join(expected_full))
print("submitted:", " ".join(submitted))
print("submitted balanced:", balanced(submitted))
print("submitted starts with input:", submitted[:len(inp)] == inp)
print("submitted suffix (the added part):", submitted[len(inp):])
print("submitted equals expected full sequence:", submitted == expected_full)
